description: Find a macro-economic series by name or country — CPI, policy and market interest rates, mortgage rates, equity indices, house and residential, real and commercial property prices, industrial production, commodities, currencies and effective exchange rates, credit-to-GDP gaps, current accounts, reserves and reserve-currency shares. Covers 180 countries, some back to 1920. Returns each series' ticker and the span it actually covers. `country` takes either a name ('Switzerland') or an ISO-3 code ('CHE'). There are tens of thousands of series, so they are searched rather than listed.
name: search_macro_indicators
title: Search macro indicators
